legend: Sheets with a paracortical distribution of the tumour cells (<<29952>>). A more compact arrangement of spindle to ovoid cells is seen in this field, displaying a storiform growth pattern (<<30428>>).

Sheets of spindle cells with irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and typically small nucleoli (<<29953>>). Tumour cells can display occasional nuclear grooves (<<29954>>). High magnification shows pleomorphic ovoid nuclei, distinct nucleoli, and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm with some multinucleated forms (<<30427>>). Sheets and nests of tumour cells exhibit an epithelioid appearance with reniform nuclei and occasional mitoses (<<30448>>).
